invariants: No original ink may be omitted or represented twice. Refused material remains in all denominators.
A protected formula may acquire a native parent only if it already shares source glyph evidence and that entire parent fits the unchanged formula vertical band.
Conflicting-role blocks preserve their complete intersecting native parent. Unknown content is attached to complete native text/paint parents, never a tail fragment atlas.
Overlapping source parents or interleaving/shared output intervals are coarsened to a protected parent. Each merge reduces node count.
If source ink lacks a parent, an anchor is missing, or all content collapses to one uncertain parent, return the original full page and score automatic reflow as failed.
Every retained word-reflow bitmap comes from the unchanged previous invocation; no new text/line segmentation rules.
No per-paper text matching,regex,threshold exception,manual algorithm input boxes,or output-informed edits.
stop: One frozen mechanism-regression pass. Holdout may run once only if a real input is subsequently authorized and materialized against the unchanged code. No further tuning.
